goals.statement:
def DisjointSAT : Prop := ∀ (f g : CNF), DisjointCNFVars f g →
  (Satisfiable (List.append f g) ↔ Satisfiable f ∧ Satisfiable g)

def FreshenNamespaces : Prop := ∀ (f g : CNF),
  DisjointCNFVars (renameCNF leftVar f) (renameCNF rightVar g)

def ClauseRestriction : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat → Bool) (x : Nat) (b : Bool) (c : Clause),
  evalRestrictedClause a (restrictClause x b c) = evalClause (assignVar a x b) c

def CNFRestriction : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat → Bool) (x : Nat) (b : Bool) (f : CNF),
  evalCNF a (restrictCNF x b f) = evalCNF (assignVar a x b) f
